subject: general
question: World Wetland Day was celebrated on 2 February 2022. What was theme of this year?

options.text: Wetland's action for people and nature

solution:
The correct answer is __**Wetland's action for people and nature.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wetlands **are vital for the **survival **of various species of **plants and animals.** 
 
• They also provide numerous **ecosystem services**, including **water purification, flood control, and carbon sequestration.**
 
• The theme of this year's World Wetland Day, **"****Wetland's action for people and nature",** emphasizes the importance of wetlands in providing benefits to people and nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Wetlands and Biodiversity," also highlights the significance of wetlands in **supporting biodiversity**.

 
 
• Wetlands are home to various** plant and animal species,** many of which are endangered.
 
 
 
• "Wetlands and climate change," emphasizes the role of wetlands in **mitigating the impacts of climate change**.
 
 
• Wetlands store carbon and help **reduce greenhouse gas emissions.**
 
 
 
• "Wetlands and water," highlights the importance of wetlands in providing **clean water.**
 
 
• **​**Wetlands act as **natural filters, removing pollutants and impurities** from water.
